Version 1.0.0

- Initial release of the skill to prepare Dataify builder requests for the crunchbase.com scraper family rooted at crunchbase_company_by-url.
- Guides users to select a scraper tool (by Chinese name), gather required parameters, and generate a curl command for Dataify API.
- Supports both macOS/Linux and Windows PowerShell setups for environment variables.
- Handles multiple parameter values with alignment and single/multi-row JSON array construction.
- Ensures retention of human-readable Chinese labels for selectable parameters unless requested otherwise.
